test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: **Identify how will you say that "The doctor treated the victims of the violence very carefully", in the passive voice.**

options.text: The doctor was very careful while providing treatment to the victims
The doctor's care was shown to the victims of the violence
The victims of the violence were treated very carefully by the doctor
The victims were treated attentively by the doctor

solution:
The correct answer is: **The victims of the violence were treated very carefully by the doctor.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence is in the passive voice as the subject (**the victims of the violence**) is receiving the action of the verb (**treated**), instead of performing it.
 
• The sentence follows the passive voice structure: **Object + auxiliary verb (were) + past participle of main verb (treated) + by + subject (the doctor).__**
 
• The sentence emphasizes the action of treating the victims carefully, rather than the doctor's care itself.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**.
